Nikhil: heads-up — rk-edge-int8 bring-up: anchor NDCG +1.6% but MRR -2.1% on live-sampled. Canary CTR -1.3%. Observed after switching to per-channel symmetric int8. Any ideas?
Sara: Can you paste eval flags and which anchors?
Nikhil: ./eval_rerank --model rk-edge-int8 --anchors anchor_public,live-sampled --candidates 100 --seed 21 --metrics ndcg,mrr,top1_swap. We used prod sampler binary.
Felix: Two quick checks: tokenizer parity and candidate ordering. Did the canary run with the same sampler stability flag?
Nikhil: Offline eval used stability=true; canary had stability=false for freshness.
Aria: ordering mismatch could explain CTR even if NDCG is up on anchors. Also check tie-handling codepath — small logit deltas from int8 flip ties.
Sara: Run a paired job: int8 with stability=true against live-sampled. Also run fp16 with stability=false to isolate quant vs ordering.
CI-Bot: queued job 7409876550: paired-stability-probe (seed=21).
Felix: Also dump top1_swap by query-length and by candidate similarity. Int8 rounding often increases swaps for long or high-similarity pools.
Nikhil: quick numbers: sampled_live | NDCG -0.2% | MRR -1.9% | top1_swap_rate 0.058 -> 0.101. Long queries (>40 tokens) drive most of the swap increase.
Aria: That suggests kernel/sequence-length interaction. Which runtime kernel was selected for long sequences?
Nikhil: runtime log: long sequences used kvpack-int8-kv2.
Sara: Action items: 1) re-run int8 with stability=true (job queued), 2) run fp16 forcing kvpack-int8 kernel to see kernel effect, 3) prototype a tiny post-quant logit rescale to reduce tie flips.
Felix: I'll open a PR reverting a recent tie-break change that made ties favour freshness; maybe combined with int8 it amplifies swaps.
CI-Bot: job 7409876550 finished: int8+stability=true -> top1_swap_rate reduced to 0.079, MRR delta -1.2%. fp16+kvpack-int8 (forced) -> MRR -1.8%. Hybrid run (keep last MLP fp16) -> MRR -0.3%.
Aria: hybrid recovering MRR is a strong signal that final dense quant loss is main factor. We should prefer hybrid for models with long-query traffic.
Sara: For immediate mitigation: pin stability=true for canary and block full roll until hybrid canary verifies CTR. Also add tokenization checksum and sampler-stability to bring-up checklist.
Nikhil: agreed. I'll pause rollout and run hybrid canary. Felix, post PR for tie-break revert. Aria, can you prototype logit rescale for a 1k probe?
Felix: on it, PR #1784 opened.
Aria: will run 1k logit-rescale probe and post numbers.
Sara: add onboarding doc entry: "verify kernel selection, sampler stability parity, and prefer hybrid quant for long-seq-heavy models".
Nikhil: thanks team — update thread with PR/canary ids when ready. :thumbsup:
